item.title: Texas student walkouts: Elgin ISD students protest ICE operations
item.description: This comes after hundreds of students walked out of class and off campus across multiple Central Texas districts to protest ICE operations and immigration policies.

item.title: FedEx driver struck, injured; APD looking for vehicle that fled scene

item.title: UT Austin creates new unit for campus safety
item.description: The University of Texas is creating a new unit for campus safety. UT said it is focused on coordination and long-term planning.UT President Jim Davis announced Tuesday the University is consolidating several safety resources into a single campus safety unit. item.title: Judge blocks Texas law prohibiting state investment in anti-fossil fuel companies
item.description: The judge decided Senate Bill 13, which prompted an $8.5 billion hit to BlackRock, violates two amendments to the U.S. Constitution.

item.title: AI, cameras and drones: Texas DPS' 5-year enforcement plan rooted in surveillance
item.description: The plan largely involves the use of artificial intelligence tools, drones, flock cameras and other technology to react to crimes as fast as possible — in some cases, before they even happen.
